top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon reviewing children files, one child did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not notify parent in a timely manner of a situation involving their child.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: According to the Texas Comptroller website, the business entity's Franchise Tax Account Status is Inactive/Forfeited. The operation is currently providing care to children with an inactive status.

top_violation_types.title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An updated immunization record is needed for one child enrolled.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Fire extinguisher in the vehicle used for transportation has not been serviced. Fire extinguisher is empty at the time of inspection.
